sources.what: The photographs that the sheets of the countries show, each a file of Commons that a sheet names (scripts/data/profiles/<country>.json) or the one chosen for the head of the sheet of a country nobody has written of (scripts/data/profiles-heads.json). items: the titles of those of each sheet, by the id of its country (photos). files: what Commons says of each file, by its title: SHA-1, bytes, MIME type, width and height of the original, licence and its address, author, credit, whether it must be attributed, restrictions other than copyright, and its page; and where the picture of it that Wikimedia draws, 1920 px wide, is kept in this branch (picture): the original is not brought. The pictures are under photos/files, each named after the SHA-1 of its original.
sources.es: Fotografías de las fichas de los países
